title: Accounts Assistant
description:
More 2 Life is part of the Key Group of companies and has been a pioneering force in the Equity Release market since its launch in 2008. Today, operating from our offices in Preston, we help over 1000 people every month to confidently release cash from their homes, significantly growing year on year to become one of the largest lifetime mortgage lenders in the UK.

We are hiring for a Temporary Accounts Assistant to join our busy transactional finance team for a period of 3 months. As our Accounts Assistant you will be responsible for ensuring that all more 2life financial transactions within your remit are accounted for accurately and on a timely basis and to support key stakeholders as and when required.

Main duties and responsibilities;
- To process system generated interface files
- To monitor fund requests and reconcile facility balances
- To post financial transactions into the accounting system in a timely and accurate manner into multiple companies
- To produce broker commission payments and statements
- To reconcile bank accounts and post transactions to the general ledger.

Key knowledge, skills and experience:
- Experience of computerised accounting systems.
- Experience of posting to multiple company Nominal, Sales and Purchase ledgers.
- Experience of working with Microsoft Office packages.
- Awareness of the importance of processing and posting data accurately.

Most of all we look for people who display and work around the core values of our business:

Ambitious - to break ground to help our customers enjoy a better retirement.
Supportive - relationships are key to everything we do.
Personal - going above and beyond to offer exceptional service.
Integrity - honest, true and transparent in all our relationships.
Responsive - whatever the challenge we'll deliver the right result.
Expert - experts in our field, our thirst for knowledge never stops

Benefits:
- 23 days holiday, plus bank holidays. Rising to 28 based on length of service.
- Additional holiday purchase scheme
- 1 charity day
- Tier 1 pension (5% Employee, 8% Employer)
- Simply Health
- Life Assurance

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper

Remote 16-24 Hours per Week Competitive Salary DOE

Join a Growing Business in a Flexible, Part-Time Bookkeeping Role

Reed Accountancy are delighted to be recruiting for an experienced and proactive Bookkeeper on behalf of a growing business operating within the manufacturing and construction support sector.

Apply Now

title: Bookkeeper

title: Sales Ledger Administrator / Service Administrator
description:
We are recruiting on behalf of an established automotive business for a Sales Ledger Administrator / Service Administrator to join its busy team in Bolton.

This is a varied role combining accounts administration, sales ledger and service department support. It would suit someone with experience in accounts or motor retail, particularly within a service department, who enjoys working with figures, coordinating administrative processes and delivering excellent customer service.

You will play a key role in ensuring service jobs are administered efficiently, invoices are raised accurately and customers receive a professional, responsive service.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts & Invoicing
- Raising and processing customer invoices for servicing, repairs and maintenance work.
- Checking job cards, labour hours, parts used and associated costs to ensure accurate invoicing.
- Maintaining sales ledger records and ensuring customer accounts are kept up to date.
- Investigating and resolving invoice discrepancies and account queries.
- Allocating payments, assisting with account reconciliations and supporting credit control activities.
- Monitoring completed jobs awaiting invoicing to ensure work is billed promptly.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting month-end procedures.

Service Administration
- Providing day-to-day administrative support to the Service Department.
- Processing service documentation, job cards, work orders and associated paperwork.
- Supporting Service Advisors with vehicle bookings, service records and customer updates where required.
- Liaising with workshop technicians, parts departments and service colleagues to ensure job information is complete.
- Coordinating paperwork for servicing, repairs, maintenance and warranty claims where applicable.
- Monitoring the progress of service jobs and following up on outstanding documentation.
- Responding to customer telephone and email enquiries professionally.
- Updating customer and vehicle records accurately on internal systems.
- Assisting with purchase orders, parts documentation and general service administration.
- Ensuring all completed work is documented correctly and ready for invoicing.

Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in an accounts, sales ledger or accounts administration role in an automotive/motor retail evviornment involving service administration and invoicing
- Understanding of customer invoicing, job cards and financial documentation.
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Excel and the ability to learn new systems.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise workloads in a busy environment.
- A proactive approach to resolving queries and maintaining accurate records.

Experience within a motor trade service department and familiarity with dealer management systems such as Kerridge/Autoline would be advantageous.

Working Hours

Flexible start times are available, with the option to start between 6:00am and 9:30am, working eight hours per day.

The Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and detail-focused, with the ability to balance financial accuracy with efficient service administration. You will be comfortable liaising with customers and colleagues, managing competing priorities and ensuring service paperwork and invoicing are completed within deadlines.

What's on Offer?

Salary of £25,000 £30,000, depending on experience, flexible start times, the opportunity to join an established automotive business, a varied position combining accounts, invoicing and service administration within a supportive team environment and opportunities to develop your skills.

title: Junior Office Administrator
description:
Junior Office Administrator

Location: Chorley, PR1 7 NY

Employment type: Full Time

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, Onsite.

What s in it for you

We believe in looking after our people, and it shows. When you join Ipsum, you re not just taking a job, you re starting a career with real support behind it.?
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays with the option to buy more
- Group Personal Pension Plan
- Career development & progression with the opportunity to earn professional qualifications
- 24/7 access to a virtual GP? and Mental health support & counselling services?

- Life assurance cover?
- Long service recognition?
- Enhanced Maternity Pay
- Active local social committees?
- Regular social events?
- Paid volunteering opportunities in your community?

About the role

As an Office Administrator, you will provide day-to-day administrative support to the business, helping ensure the office runs efficiently and colleagues, customers and visitors receive a professional and welcoming experience.

This is a varied role where no two days are the same. You'll support a range of business activities including reception duties, document management, office coordination, meeting arrangements, post handling, visitor management and general administration.

You'll also work closely with different teams across the business, supporting new starter administration, event coordination, marketing activities and the ordering of office supplies, workwear and equipment.

This role would suit someone who is organised, approachable and enjoys working with people. Whether you're looking to build your administration experience or take the next step in your career, you'll have the opportunity to develop a broad range of skills while supporting the wider business.

As a Junior Office Administrator, you will
- Answer incoming calls, take messages, transfer enquiries and monitor shared inboxes.
- Manage incoming and outgoing post, including sorting and distributing mail and coordinating courier collections.
- Support document management through scanning, printing, photocopying, binding and electronic filing.
- Welcome visitors to the office, ensuring they receive a professional and friendly experience.
- Support meetings by arranging refreshments, ordering lunches and preparing meeting rooms.
- Maintain office supplies, including stationery, kitchen stock and meeting room facilities.
- Provide general administrative support, including data entry, updating contact records and assisting teams across the business.
- Coordinate new starter welcome packs, including preparing and posting items to employees across the business.
- Support the Marketing team with the ordering and organisation of branded merchandise.
- Assist with the coordination of internal and external events, including room bookings and logistics.
- Arrange meetings and diary bookings, ensuring rooms, refreshments and supporting materials are organised.
- Coordinate the ordering of PPE and workwear as required.

About you

We're looking for someone who is organised, reliable and enjoys working in a busy office environment where no two days are the same. You'll be a confident communicator who enjoys helping others, building positive relationships and providing excellent service to colleagues, customers and visitors.

You take pride in being well organised, paying attention to detail and ensuring tasks are completed accurately and on time. Whether you're arranging meetings, supporting visitors, managing office administration or helping colleagues across the business, you'll be comfortable juggling a variety of responsibilities and adapting to changing priorities.

You'll be someone who is proactive, approachable and willing to get involved wherever needed. Previous administration, reception, customer service or office support experience would be beneficial, however attitude, enthusiasm and a willingness to learn are just as important.

As this is a fully office-based role, we're looking for someone who enjoys being part of a team, collaborating with colleagues and providing hands-on support from our office location. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to develop their administration skills and become an important part of a supportive and welcoming team.

Our commitment to Equal Opportunities

We re proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and experiences, and we re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce.
Before applying, please review our Privacy Policy to understand how we process your data in line with GDPR.

Next steps

If you re interested in this opportunity, please apply or reach out to the Talent Team for more info!

title: Gambling Harms Project Co-ordinator
description:
Help reduce gambling harms and improve access to support across Preston. Join Preston Muslim Forum to build partnerships, raise awareness and make a difference to individuals and families affected by gambling-related harm.

Gambling Harms Project Co-ordinator

Location: Preston, PR1 6 QH

£28,860 pro rata

Part-time, 16 hours per week

Fixed term for 12 months, with continuation subject to further funding

About Preston Muslim Forum

Preston Muslim Forum is a registered charity serving people of all ages, faiths, cultures and backgrounds across Preston.

Rooted in the community and open to all, they provide services and facilities that advance economic and social welfare and improve people s life chances. They have particular expertise in reaching communities who face barriers to mainstream support.

About the Role

Reporting to the Operations Manager, you ll coordinate and deliver Preston Muslim Forum s community-based gambling harms programme.

You ll work with faith institutions, community groups, frontline services and public sector partners to reduce stigma, increase awareness and improve access to support for individuals and families affected by gambling-related harm.

Your responsibilities will include:

Building relationships with community, faith, voluntary and statutory organisations, developing referral pathways and partnership opportunities.

Representing the project at meetings, events and networks.

Organising and delivering community awareness sessions and events, engaging underserved communities and promoting available support services.

Recruiting and supporting community champions and volunteers.

Coordinating and delivering gambling harms awareness sessions and full-day accredited training for volunteers, practitioners and faith leaders.

Managing project activities to achieve agreed targets and outcomes, maintaining training records, feedback and evaluation data.

Recording monitoring data, attendance, case studies and evidence of impact on the project database, and preparing reports for funders and partners.

About You

You ll bring strong community engagement skills and the ability to build trusted relationships with people from diverse backgrounds.

Preston Muslim Forum is looking for:

Experience delivering community-based projects.

Experience organising events, workshops or training.

Experience working with faith communities and minority ethnic groups.

Strong partnership-building and stakeholder engagement skills.

Excellent communication, organisational and reporting skills.

Knowledge of gambling harms, addiction, mental health or public health.

An understanding of safeguarding and trauma-informed practice.

How to Apply

If you have the skills and experience required for this Gambling Harms Project Co-ordinator position based in Preston, click apply today and check your inbox for an email providing more information on how to tailor your application and provide a cover letter or any supporting documents.

Preston Muslim Forum is committed to equality of opportunity and welcomes applications from people of all backgrounds, faiths and communities. They are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and adults at risk and expect all staff and volunteers to share this commitment.

No agencies please.

Other suitable skills and experience include: Community Project Coordinator, Community Engagement Officer, Gambling Harms Coordinator, Community Outreach Worker, Health Improvement Officer, Public Health Project Officer, Charity Project Coordinator, Community Development Worker, Volunteer Coordinator, Training Coordinator.

title: Document Controller

The role is working a 4 day working week - Monday to Thursday.

Salary is c 26-30,000 per annum plus 25 days' holiday and bank holidays, pension, healthcare etc

About the Document Controller role:

The role involves managing project documentation, maintaining accurate records and ensuring all required quality documentation is completed and submitted in line with client requirements.

Key Responsibilities for the Document Controller:
- Compile, review and maintain project documentation and lifetime records.
- Check documents for accuracy, completeness and compliance with requirements.
- Coordinate document reviews, corrections and client submissions.
- Maintain document registers, filing structures, scanning, page numbering and retention records.
- Monitor documentation progress and report issues, risks and outstanding actions.
- Support internal and external audits, non-conformance reporting and corrective actions.

title: Supply Chain Coordinator
description:

Purpose of the Role

title: Document Controller
description:
We are currently recruiting for an experienced Document Controller to join a well-established construction main contractor.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing, organising and maintaining project documentation, ensuring all information is accurate, up to date and distributed to the relevant teams throughout the construction process.

Working closely with Project Managers, Site Managers, Design Teams and subcontractors, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth running of projects from initial stages through to completion.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and maintain project documentation, including drawings, specifications, technical submissions, schedules and reports.
- Set up and maintain document registers, project folders, distribution lists and electronic filing systems.
- Ensure all project information is correctly uploaded, issued, tracked and archived using the company's document management system.
- Maintain accurate revision control, ensuring project teams have access to the latest approved drawings and documentation.
- Coordinate the distribution of information between Project Managers, Site Managers, design teams, consultants and subcontractors.
- Maintain trackers for drawings, technical submissions, RFIs, approvals and outstanding project information.
- Monitor submission deadlines, follow up outstanding documentation and highlight potential delays to project teams.
- Support project meetings by preparing documentation, maintaining action logs and providing document status updates.
- Liaise with subcontractors and suppliers to ensure all required documentation is received and accurately recorded.
- Support internal audits and ensure documentation complies with company procedures and client requirements.

Experience & Requirements
- Previous experience working as a Document Controller within the construction industry.
- Experience working for a main contractor is preferred.
- Strong understanding of construction documentation, drawing registers, revision control and approval processes.
- Experience using document management systems such as Procore
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Ability to manage documentation and deadlines across multiple projects.
- Good communication skills and the ability to work with both site-based and office-based teams.

Interested in the vacancy? Call Jack on (phone number removed) to discuss further.

title: Receptionist/ Administrator
description: To provide a professional, friendly and efficient reception and administrative service within a busy GP practice. The role involves acting as the first point of contact for patients, managing telephone and face-to-face enquiries, booking appointments, maintaining patient records and providing general administrative support to the clinical team. Alongside reception duties, the post holder is responsible for the referral process, including processing routine and urgent referrals, submitting referrals to hospitals and specialist services, monitoring outstanding referrals, liaising with external healthcare providers and keeping patients informed of referral progress. The role requires excellent communication, organisation and time-management skills, the ability to prioritise competing demands, attention to detail and a compassionate approach to patient care. The post holder must maintain patient confidentiality, follow practice policies and ensure that both reception and referral responsibilities are carried out accurately, efficiently and within appropriate timescales. Please note this role requires the candidate to work between the hours of 1.30pm to 6.30pm. Candidate must be able to commit to these working hours. Responsible for providing a professional, friendly and efficient reception and administrative service, acting as the first point of contact for patients both face-to-face and by telephone. Duties include managing appointments, patient registrations, prescription requests, telephone enquiries and general administration. Responsible for processing referrals via the NHS e-Referral Service (e-RS), maintaining accurate patient records on EMIS, managing correspondence and supporting the clinical and management teams. Ensuring patient confidentiality and GDPR compliance, delivering compassionate patient care, recognising and escalating urgent concerns, prioritising workloads and working effectively with colleagues and external healthcare providers in accordance with practice policies and NHS guidelines. Main Duties and Responsibilities Act as the first point of contact for patients, both face-to-face and over the telephone. Answer telephone calls and deal with patient enquiries in a professional and courteous manner. Book, amend and cancel patient appointments. Register new patients and update patient records. Process prescription requests and general administrative enquiries. Process routine, urgent and two-week-wait referrals. Submit referrals via the NHS e-Referral Service (e-RS). Ensure referral documentation is accurate and complete. Monitor and track outstanding referrals. Chase delayed referrals and liaise with hospitals and specialist departments. Respond to patient enquiries regarding referral progress. Update patient records with referral information and correspondence. Scan, code and attach documents to patient records. Process incoming and outgoing correspondence. Provide general administrative support to GPs, nurses and the practice team. Identify urgent patient concerns and escalate to the appropriate clinician. Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with GDPR and information governance requirements. Prioritise daily workloads and manage competing reception and referral responsibilities. Work effectively as part of the practice team, following practice policies and procedures. Maintain a professional, compassionate and patient-focused approach at all times.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: An exciting opportunity has arisen for a highly motivated individual to join our friendly Reception team. If you are looking for a part-time role in a friendly rural location, we may have the ideal position for you. The position is for 20 hours per week, days and times to be confirmed at interview. The ideal candidate will have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, be empathetic and have an understanding of the importance of confidentiality.They will understand and contribute fully to the functioning of both the Reception team and the wider Practice team. Ideally, the successful candidate will be able to work effectively and unsupervised in sometimes complex and unpredictable situations, using their own judgement, resourcefulness and local knowledge within defined parameters. See Full Job Description attached Summary of Responsibilities below:- Provide a reception service to patients and healthcare professionals both within and outside the Practice Respond to all queries and requests for assistance in an efficient and courteous manner, answering general enquiries and explaining Practice procedures Understand fully Practice appointment systems, including regular and incidental variations, and report any problems Receive and accurately record requests for home visits, assessing urgency in accordance with Practice protocols Ensure patient records are accurate, up-to-date and made available to clinicians as needed Ensure that appropriate correspondence, reports, results, etc. are recorded, actioned and stored in accordance with Practice protocols and the Data Protection Act 1998 Respond to requests for access to medical records, reports, etc. in accordance with the Access to Health Records 1990 and Access to Medical Records Act 1988 Ensure all information, both incoming and outgoing, is actioned in an appropriate and timely manner. Use judgement to interpret and assess the relative urgency of each request. Communicate with people at all levels in a polite and constructive manner, with proper regard to confidentiality Make appropriate use of the available channels of communication, e.g. telephone, sms, email, written, face-to-face Know under which circumstances clinical and non-clinical advice should be sought Assess the risk associated with any unusual situation and seek guidance where appropriate

title: Receptionist / Care Navigator
description: We have two part time positions available both are 25 hours per week. The right candidate will need to be able to work a selection of shift's Monday through to Friday. Our shifts start from 7.30am till 6.30pm. Working hours are dependent on the needs of the business and may change. Extra hours will be required as and when to cover annual leave and sickness. Flexibility is a must for this post. Please note you should complete your application as soon as possible as this job advert may close sooner than expected if we receive a sufficient amount of applications. This is a fast paced role, helping to provide a welcoming and professional service to patients, staff and visitors to the practice. Therefore it is important that you are a quick thinker, be able to multi task and remain calm under pressure. The ideal candidate must a be self-motivated person who has a passion for delivering excellent patient care, enthusiastic and friendly.Our Care Navigators work closely with our clinical team and wider colleagues in person and via email, therefore excellent communication skills and strong I.T skills are essential for the role. This is a varied role dealing with reception duties, prescriptions and administrative tasks. The candidate must be able to be empathetic towards patients, a problem solver and be able to use their own initiative. You should be able to work as part of a team but also be able to work on your own. Experience is not essential for this role and training will be provided. TITLE : Receptionist / Care Navigator LOCATION : Ash Tree House, Church Street,Kirkham,PR4 2SE RESPONSIBLE TO : Reception Manager ACCOUNTABLE TO : Practice Manager General Duties As a Receptionist / Care Navigator you will be required to: ensure that all queries from patients are handled efficiently and courteously keep surgery premises tidy and safe at all times maintain patient confidentiality at all times Principle Duties 1. Meet and greet patients, providing a friendly and helpful welcome. 2. Navigate patients to the right clinician and service. 3. Make new and follow-up appointments for patients via the telephone or in person at the Reception Desk. 4. Receive telephone calls and deal with enquiries/messages and/or direct them to the appropriate person. 5. Receive and record all requests for home visits, repeat prescriptions, including on-line requests etc. 6. Manage repeat prescriptions and ensure that these are signed and checked by the doctor before handing to patients. 7. Provide administrative support to clinical staff and other members of the team, such as scanning and data input. 8. Opening and closing the premises including checking heating and ventilation at the start and end of the surgery day. 9. Provide support and guidance to new staff during their induction. 10. Attend and participate in Practice and Reception Team meetings, as required. Overall Responsibility Undertake any other appropriate duties or responsibilities as directed by the Managment team or Partners To ensure effective communication with all Clinicians and other Practice and Community staff. Be aware of and adhere to Practice policies in relation to Health and Safety at Work and Fire Precautions To attend appropriate training courses Where necessary relevant training in the operation of new or unfamiliar equipment, software or procedures will be provided or arranged. This Job Description is not intended to form a part of the contract of employment or to be a complete list of duties and responsibilities, but a guide for information to the job. This Job Description will be periodically reviewed in the light of developing work requirements. The individual in post will be expected to contribute towards this revision. Confidentiality In the course of your duties, you may have access to confidential information about patients, staff or other General Practice business. On no account must such information be divulged to anyone who is not authorised to receive it. Confidentiality of information must be preserved at all times whether at or away from work. Data Protection Act, 1998 Carry out any requirements within the duties applicable to the Data Protection Act. Health and Safety at Work Act, 1974 Observe all responsibilities and carry out all duties, whether general to all employees or specific to the post, relating to Health and Safety in accordance with the Practice Safety policies and any statutory requirements. Quality Assurance Every employee is personally responsible for the quality of the work, which they individually perform. It is their duty to seek to attain the highest standards achievable both individually and collectively within their knowledge, skills, and resources available to them in the furtherance of the Practices philosophy of pursuing quality in all its services. Outside Employment/Outside Interests If you have other work or outside interest, this must not conflict with your duties and responsibilities or your attendance for work as an employee of the Practice. It is a condition of employment that you must inform the Practice Manager before taking up post of any private practice, work for outside agencies or other employers, voluntary work, or outside interest you have or propose to have. This is to ensure there is no question of creating a conflict of interest with your Practice duties. You must therefore seek the Partners approval before taking on any such other work or outside interest at any time after entering the Practices employment. Working Time Directive You are required to comply with the regulations governing working time. Harassment and Bullying The Practice condemns all forms of harassment and bullying and is actively seeking to promote a workplace where employees are treated with dignity, respect and without bias. Equal Opportunities The Practice actively promotes equality of opportunity for all its employees. Fire Training Each member of the Practice has a statutory obligation to attend a Fire Lecture each year. It is the responsibility of each member of staff to ensure that they comply with this legal requirement. No Smoking Policy The Practice has a no smoking policy. Disclosure Criminal Records Bureau This post is subject to standard disclosure under the Criminal Records Bureau.
